record.purpose: Find the relevant county office and verify incumbent and jurisdiction before any correspondence. This is not a confirmed separate recipient.

sources.source_title: Mendocino County — Contact Us, Public Defender
sources.stated_purpose: Public defender office inquiries within its mandate, including representation of eligible clients; not general civil legal assistance.
sources.limitations: Confirm current mailbox, jurisdiction and appropriate remit before correspondence. Not a substitute for designated complaint, crime-reporting, legal filing or client intake procedures. Do not send confidential records through ordinary email. Deliverability not tested. Address explicit in indexed county contact page; subsequent page request returned HTTP 403. Recheck directly before use.
